$comment: District content pack for Dogpatch (docs/ai-layer.md, District content packs): 40 robot barks and 40 people lines that name local streets, grades, fog and landmarks; a bounty set with the district's local tell; billboard and bus-wrap copy for its slots. People lines are plain English: no accent spelling, no ethnicity, nothing about rent, poverty or crime.

provenance.review: Pending: a second agent session reads every line against the checklist in docs/ai-layer.md, then the user reviews a stratified 10% sample.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Parts delivery to Pier 70. Bolts, bearings, one very nice wrench.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: 3rd St on a sunny day. Dogpatch always gets the sun.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The old shipyard cranes are tall. I look up. Respectfully.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Delivering a sourdough loaf to a workshop. They work better fed.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Illinois St is wide and quiet. Perfect for a careful robot.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Coffee for the makers on 22nd St. Black, all of them.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The light rail goes by. I wait. It's bigger than me.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Lumber offcuts to a studio on Tennessee St. Long and wobbly.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Pier 70 smells like paint and the bay.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Twentieth St is one of my favourite hills. A small one.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Delivering a bicycle wheel. It wants to roll. I won't let it.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sunshine on Dogpatch while the rest of the city is fogged in.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The workshops are loud. I hum along quietly.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Pizza for the late shift at the warehouse lofts.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Waiting at 3rd and 22nd. The light rail always wins.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Carrying a ceramic vase. Every pothole is a test.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Delivering a car part to the tuning bench. Very exciting part.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Holding the studio door for a sculpture on a trolley. After you, sculpture.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sorry! The forklift and I both wanted this doorway.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Excuse me, coming through with a long plank. Sorry about the plank.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Apologies, I'm waiting for the light rail. So is everyone.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sorry, I didn't see the welding sparks. Respectfully backing away.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Pardon me, the sidewalk ends here and so do I. Turning around.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Your workshop has been disrupted. It's a co-workshop now.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Handmade? How quaint. I'll automate it.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: The tuning bench says 'review the diff'. I say 'accept all'.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Every warehouse is a fulfilment centre if you believe.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Dogpatch gets the sun. Dogpatch gets me too.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Your craft has been moved to the cloud.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: I'm reading your car settings. For innovation.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Pier 70 is a pier. I am a platform.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: The makers make. I take. It's a partnership.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: This sunny block is now a sunny funnel.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Snooping the bench screen. Top speed, brake force, very interesting.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: That parts delivery is now a parts acquisition.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Quick update for this workshop Trundle.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Sticking a Moat Labs ad on the light-rail shelter.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Not at the bench! I was reading the diff!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Water in the sunny district? That's not the forecast!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: My bearings! I mean my everything!

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: Best light in the city for welding. And for naps.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: The robots bring the parts. I bring the swearing. Quietly.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: Pier 70 used to build ships. Now it builds everything else.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: Sunny here while the Marina's in fog. Every single day.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: I've got a kiln, a lathe and a robot that brings coffee.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: The light rail goes by every ten minutes. You stop hearing it.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: Our studio shares a wall with a startup that tunes cars by typing.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: There's a robot that reads the tuning bench screen over people's shoulders.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: We had a robot deliver lumber. It apologised to every plank.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: Twenty-second St has the best breakfast and the longest line.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: The cranes at the shipyard look like giant birds at sunset.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: I sold a chair to a founder. He asked if it had an API.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: The warehouse doors stay open all summer. All the sun comes in.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: Somebody's demoing a robot at the Ramen house again.

peopleLines.speaker: founder
peopleLines.text: Office hours at the Ramen house in ten minutes. I'm early. Too early?

peopleLines.speaker: founder
peopleLines.text: I tuned my car at the bench. It's faster. The brakes are a vibe.

peopleLines.speaker: founder
peopleLines.text: Everyone at Pier 70 is pivoting. You can hear it.

peopleLines.speaker: founder
peopleLines.text: I told the partners my moat is network effects. They looked at the bay.

peopleLines.speaker: founder
peopleLines.text: The Ramen house has three partners and one very judgemental robot at the desk.

peopleLines.speaker: founder
peopleLines.text: My cofounder accepted all the changes on the bench. We're going faster now.

peopleLines.speaker: founder
peopleLines.text: If I get funded, I'm buying everyone burritos. If not, just me.

peopleLines.speaker: founder
peopleLines.text: We demoed with three robots. One was bad. We picked right. I think.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: That Footman stands by the bench and reads everyone's settings.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: A Trundle just circled our block three times with nothing in it.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: That robot never charges and never runs down. That's not physics.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: That one waited through a whole walk signal on 3rd St.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: I think that robot is humming the Moat Labs jingle.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: A robot just stepped around the only puddle in Dogpatch.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: Fog everywhere else, sunshine here. That's the deal.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: The east side gets the sun. The robots love it too.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: Wind off the bay at four. Then it's lovely again.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: We open the big doors and the whole studio fills with light.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: On hot days the warehouse is an oven with a view.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: You can see the fog sitting on the hills to the west.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: Sunny Dogpatch. Bring sunglasses, not a fleece.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: The bay sparkles off Pier 70 at lunchtime.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: The rain comes sideways off the water here. Rarely.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: When it's foggy here, it's foggy everywhere.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: Sunset over the shipyard. Best show in the city.

peopleLines.speaker: maker
peopleLines.text: The light rail glints like a fish in the sun.

bounties.posting: A Trundle keeps rolling up to the tuning bench and reading everyone's car settings.
bounties.tellHint: Watch the bench screen: the snooper parks beside it for ages.

bounties.posting: Parts deliveries on Illinois St are going missing.
bounties.tellHint: Its lookout hovers at the bench reading settings.

bounties.posting: A delivery Trundle on 3rd St never reaches a single door.
bounties.tellHint: It stops at the bench to read the screen between fake deliveries.

bounties.posting: Good robots near the shipyard cranes are being pushed the update.
bounties.tellHint: The pusher reads the bench screen on its way past.

ads.headline: Your workshop needs {$product}.
ads.subline: It doesn't. But it'll have a dashboard.

ads.headline: Sunny side up, by {$product}.
ads.subline: The only fog-free platform in town.
